title: Acyclicity of program gates
statement: Let $n$ be the number of input bits, let $\mathrm{prog}$ be a finite list of instructions, and let $i\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $i\leq |\mathrm{prog}|$. The gate list produced for the first $i$ instruction stages is acyclic relative to the $n$ input vertices.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $n$ of input bits
